tool_input.description: Write setUTCDate implementation, then fmt, build and run tests

result:
I rewrote `prototype_set_utc_date.rs` to implement `Date.prototype.setUTCDate`, but I have not compiled it or run the test262 tests. The shell was denied, so `cargo build`, `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` and `./t262 built-ins/Date/prototype/setUTCDate/` all still need to run.

The implementation follows the spec steps, with each step's text as a comment above its code. It uses the existing `date` support helpers, `ops::to_number`, and `time_clip`. It skips `LocalTime`/`UTC` because this method works in UTC. It does not write any helpers or touch other files.

The shell denial also blocks the check I'd planned for this one-function file: `ops::to_number` and `args.get_or_undefined` are used as in the sibling `prototype_set_date.rs`, but nothing has confirmed they compile here.
